prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Two WIDE isolated forest prop sprites, in one horizontal row of two generous custom wide cells: LEFT one long fallen rotten oak log with jagged broken end, visible annual rings, moss and a few small leaf sprouts; RIGHT one low horizontally spreading tangle of exposed old oak roots with moss in crevices. Each complete silhouette stays within central 65% of its wide cell, blank space all around. No standing trunk or canopy, no ground slab. Source 1 original mossy fallen log determines object identity and material. Pet sheets only edge/shading compatibility. Octopath Traveler HD-2D environment PIXEL ART, restrained earthy moss/olive/sage greens and weathered umber materials, cool desaturated dark hue-tinted edges, warm subtle upper-left key, broad readable color clusters, 3–4 tones/material. No fluorescent greens, candy saturation, smooth vector edges or illustrative microtexture. Upright front billboards seen from 24 degrees above. No baked ground shadows, lighting glow, fog or scenery. Actual engine lighting comes later. Strong horizontal shapes, readable when shrunk to 90–120px high. Exact pure flat #FF00FF key background, no shadow beneath, fog or backdrop. No text or labels.
source_card: Long mossy fallen log with broken ends, warm umber bark and yellow-green moss; root tangle is a required separate dressing part.
